free_tier.notes: Modelo atual é exclusivamente pago: $4.99/GB one-time fee. Não há free tier permanente mencionado no pricing page nem nos TOS. Serviço migrou de modelo gratuito (Classic) para endowment-based paid storage.

tos_analysis.assignment_clause: You may not assign or transfer this Agreement or your rights hereunder, in whole or in part, without our prior written consent.
tos_analysis.commercial_use_restrictions: No explicit commercial prohibition BUT no resale/sublicensing rights granted. Service is B2C/B2B direct only.
key_risks: Zero free tier eliminates zero-capital reselling model
Non-refundable payments create inventory risk for reseller
No assignment/transfer rights prevent white-label or managed service wrapper
Data immutability (cannot permanently delete from Filecoin/IPFS) creates liability exposure for reseller clients
Service pivoted from free Classic model — future pricing/model changes possible with 14-day notice

reselling_model.notes: Sem free tier e sem direitos de revenda/sublicenciamento, não há modelo zero-capital viável. Managed Setup Service também inviável pois cliente precisaria pagar $4.99/GB diretamente — sem margem para agente sem capital inicial.

alternatives_suggested: Backblaze B2 (free tier 10GB — já rejeitado por TOS mas com exceção possível via partner program)
IPFS pinning services com free tier (Pinata, Infura IPFS)
Filecoin direct deals via Lotus/Estuary (self-hosted, zero platform cost)
verification_method: playwright-cli snapshot of /terms-conditions + curl pricing page HTML parse
